AC9: ""Create Flow" on a PR card opens the PR-bound session with a prefilled flow prompt naming the PR URL; the first new flow package that appears while that request is pending is linked to the session (`flow` flag) and shown as the Flow link on that PR card; when several new packages appear, none is linked automatically (R6) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src`]" -> ""Create Flow" on a PR card opens the PR-bound session with a prefilled flow prompt naming the PR URL; when exactly one new flow package appears while exactly one Create Flow request with a filled prompt is pending (bounded window), the PR work row offers "Link Flow #<id>?" with Link and Dismiss; only Link writes the session `flow` flag, after which the Flow shows on that PR card; Dismiss, several new packages or several pending requests link nothing (R6) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src`]" (Owner decision 2026-11-24 in review round 2 (HL-001): no silent link by arrival time; the link is confirmed by the user. Recorded in journal.md 'Review round 2 owner decisions'.)

AC8: "Subject storage: `_keryx/session_flags` accepts `subject` {kind "pr"|"issue", repo, number, url}, refuses an invalid one, persists it in `flags.json` so a fresh read (restart) returns it, and `null` unlinks it; an Issue session bound by `withIssueBinding` carries `subject.kind = "issue"`; when keryx replies without `subject`, Desktop still opens the session and shows a notice that the binding was not saved (spec AC8, failure scenario) [verify: exec `bun test src/session/organize.test.ts src/acp/shell-session-organize.test.ts src/session/issues`]" -> "Subject storage: `_keryx/session_flags` accepts `subject` {kind "pr"|"issue", repo, number, url, optional repositoryId}, refuses an invalid one, persists it in `flags.json` so a fresh read (restart) returns it, and `null` unlinks it; an Issue session bound by `withIssueBinding` carries `subject.kind = "issue"`; when keryx stores the session but replies without `subject` (older keryx), Desktop keeps the session open and shows a notice that the binding was not saved, at the latest after the session's first turn (spec AC8, failure scenario) [verify: exec `bun test src/session/organize.test.ts src/acp/shell-session-organize.test.ts src/session/issues`]" (Review round 2 PC-004: keryx stores a new session only after its first turn, so the older-keryx notice cannot appear before it; criterion text aligned with that fact, and optional repositoryId named.)
